retrievalProfile.description: A medium-shot portrait of a musician with an electric guitar set against a dramatic, soft-focus stormy sky with high-contrast 80s typography.
triggerTerms: musician with guitar against stormy sky

recipe.visualDefinition: A smiling male musician with dark curly hair and mirrored sunglasses, wearing a black-and-white patterned shirt, holding a black hollow-body electric guitar. The background is a hazy, atmospheric sky with dark blue and white storm clouds. The composition features a clean, horizontal typographic block in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The musician's diagonal guitar neck leads the eye toward the typography.
The mirrored sunglasses reflect the bright horizon light.
The dark guitar body anchors the lower left corner against the lighter sky.
The horizontal blue bar under the main text balances the horizontal guitar neck.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned slightly off-center to the left, occupying roughly 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black guitar body provides a heavy visual weight in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face/glasses, follows the guitar neck diagonally up to the right, landing on the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame is primarily atmospheric sky, providing room for the title and subtitle.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and grays in the sky background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white high-contrast patterns in the shirt and guitar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white highlights in the clouds and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background allows the high-contrast subject to pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended sans-serif and elegant serif italics
letterConstructionRules: Primary text is ultra-wide and geometric
Secondary text is a fluid, slanted serif
Horizontal rule separates or underlines text elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on specific font weights and widths
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, wide geometric sans and a delicate, slanted serif.
graphicDevices: Subtle drop shadows on white text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, structured feel of the primary text.
Captures the elegant, high-contrast serif look of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man with dark curly hair and mirrored sunglasses, wearing a black and white patterned shirt, holding a black electric guitar. The background should be a soft-focus, atmospheric stormy sky with blue and white clouds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top right. The top line should be an extra-wide, bold, uppercase sans-serif font. Below it, add a horizontal blue gradient bar. Below the bar, add a second line of text in a lowercase, italicized serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the sky background soft-focus and atmospheric?
Is the primary text extra-wide and uppercase?
Is there a horizontal bar separating the text elements?

adjustableVariables: Color of the horizontal graphic bar
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the guitar neck does not overlap the text.
Verify the mirrored sunglasses have a realistic reflection.
Check that the shirt pattern is high-contrast black and white.
Confirm the typography is aligned to the right side of the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Musician) + Prop(Electric Guitar) + Accessory(Mirrored Shades) + Environment(Stormy Sky) + Layout(Top-Right Stacked Typography with Horizontal Rule)
